questions.stem: A pipeline must run a cleanup activity only when a Copy activity fails. How do you connect them?

options.text: By putting both in a ForEach
With an Upon failure dependency from the Copy activity to the cleanup activity

questions.explanation: Activity dependencies can be Upon success, Upon failure, Upon completion or Upon skip. Upon failure runs the next activity only when the previous one fails.

questions.stem: A Copy activity sometimes fails with a brief network timeout and works when run again. What should you change?

options.text: Set a retry count and retry interval on the activity

questions.explanation: Activity retries handle transient errors by running the activity again after an interval.

questions.stem: A Copy activity fails because a few source rows have values that can't convert to the destination column types. The business accepts losing those rows if they're logged. What do you configure?

options.text: Fault tolerance to skip incompatible rows and log them

questions.explanation: Fault tolerance lets the copy skip rows it can't write and log them for review, instead of failing the whole copy. Retries would fail the same way.

questions.stem: Put the steps of finding why a pipeline run failed in order.

options.text: Find the activity whose status is Failed
Fix the cause and run the pipeline again
Open the pipeline run from the Monitoring hub or the pipeline's run history

questions.explanation: You find the run, then the failed activity, then its error message, and only then fix the cause and run the pipeline again.
